purpose: Project-specific audit and integrity log for the 19 skills proposed by AutoSkills. This is not AutoSkills' official skills-lock.json.

officialSkillsLockJson.reason: The successful run used --dry-run. Hand-writing skills-lock.json would falsely imply that AutoSkills' installer generated and verified it. The official registry index.json was not readable through the available connector, so its bundleHash/security-review entries could not be independently checked.

registrySnapshot.integrity: Pinned GitHub blob IDs are recorded for all 19 SKILL.md files. This is immutable Git-object evidence, not a claim that AutoSkills' own SHA-256 manifest was verified.

validation.installedFilesMatchedPinnedGitBlobSha1: All unchanged bundle/license files match their pinned source blob SHA-1; two SKILL.md files intentionally differ because of documented project-specific safety overlays.
validation.notes: Candidate-level source/license/compatibility triage was performed for all 19 SKILL.md proposals. Complete companion bundles were copied and hash-verified only for the two installed skills; rejected/deferred bundles were not fully downloaded or audited file-by-file. No third-party scripts were executed. The AutoSkills registry manifest was not readable, so its official bundleHash/securityCheck metadata is unverified.
